items.name: langgenius/dify 1.19.0
items.description:
**Dify 1.19.0 brings nested workflow tracing to your observability tools.** Follow a workflow into the Workflow Tools it calls, inspect the steps inside each invocation, and keep the LLM context alongside the execution tree.

This release also makes Workflow Tools portable with App packages, adds Skill Hub automation, and makes Agent files easier to upload and preview. The bundled plugin daemon is upgraded to **0.6.14-local**.

items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.16
items.description:
## Ripple Preview

[Ripple Preview](https://ollama.com/library/ripple-preview) from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding.

```sh
ollama run ripple-preview
```

## What's Changed

- Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon
- `ollama launch claude` always routes Claude Code to the selected model
- `ollama launch` explains when a cloud model has been retired
- `/v1/responses` respects `truncation` and no longer silently truncates

items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.15
items.description:
## MiMo V2.6

Xiaomi MiMo's [mimo-v2.6](https://ollama.com/library/mimo-v2.6), a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama.

```sh
ollama run mimo-v2.6
```
